title: Bazaar Flipper
description: Live Hypixel Skyblock profit overlay for Fabric — ranks the top Bazaar flips, craft flips, and NPC arbitrage in real time, with realistic profit math (no fantasy margins). Client-side · no API key · no macros.
body:
BazaarFlip — Hypixel Skyblock profit toolkit for Fabric

  A client-side overlay that turns your Bazaar and Auction House into a live profit dashboard. No server changes, no API key required, no macros.

  What it does
  - Bazaar Flipper — fetches live Bazaar data, ranks the top buy-order → sell-offer flips by margin and volume, filters out the junk with realistic sanity caps.
  - Craft Flip calculator — finds Skyblock recipes whose ingredient cost on Bazaar is less than the crafted item's sell value. Top picks shown in the same panel.
  - NPC Flip finder — Bazaar items you can resell to NPC merchants at a profit.
  - AH Sniper HUD — rolling list of underpriced auctions ranked by absolute profit, with a §4✗ badge on rows you can't currently afford (live purse from chat +
  scoreboard).
  - Snipe alert overlay — fixed-position toast in the top-right when a new snipe lands, with a notification ding. Click it to /viewauction directly. Kill-switch stops
  everything — chat, sound, overlay, queue — the moment you disable the sniper.
  - AH Craft Finder — combines AH lowest-BINs with Bazaar ingredient prices to surface "buy parts on AH, craft, sell back" loops.
  - In-game settings via ModMenu + YACL — refresh intervals, alert thresholds, top-N rows, panel position, all live.

  Keybinds (rebindable)
  - B — toggle Bazaar Panel (when Bazaar open) or AH HUD (otherwise)
  - G — settings screen
  - N — full snipe list (Snipes | Craft AH tabs)
  - M — AH menu screen
  - C — copy top snipe to clipboard

  Commands
  - /bf help · purse · refresh · skip <uuid> · …

  Requirements
  - Fabric Loader ≥ 0.17.2, Java 21
  - Fabric API, YACL (required); ModMenu (optional)
  - Client-side only — Hypixel server doesn't see it.

  Builds
  - BazaarFlip-2.2.2.jar → Minecraft 1.21.10
  - BazaarFlip-2.2.2+1.21.11.jar → Minecraft 1.21.11


## Changelog
### 2.2.2
- Bazaar-only by default (AH sniper off); in-game "Sort Best to Buy By" selector; "Ignore Purse Check" fix; API key no longer placed in the request URL.
### 2.2.1
- Fixed craft-recipe tiers + variant item IDs; realistic liquidity-capped profit math (no fantasy margins); craft profit/hr now includes time to sell.
### 2.2.0
- Configurable Top-N, tab counts, live/stale data indicator.
